subject: Request: continuity confirmation memo to cover post-report gap (Auricore)
messages:
From: Laura Jacobs <laura.jacobs@auricore.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@auricore.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Request: continuity confirmation for SOC 2 Type II period gap

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared last month. Our procurement and security teams are finishing an external review and have one outstanding ask: a short continuity confirmation that covers the gap between the report end date (2026-09-30) and today.

Specifically, they want a dated memo that: 1) confirms there have been no material control changes since the report period end, or 2) summarizes any changes and the compensating controls in place. A single-page PDF is fine; it will be attached to our vendor file.

Can Redwood provide that? If helpful, we can accept a signed PDF or an emailed cover note. Also attaching our standard SIG spreadsheet for completeness — you do not need to re-run it, just confirm the continuity statement.

Appreciate a response by EOD 30 Nov as we have an internal audit checkpoint then.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Jacobs
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager, Auricore Health
security@auricore.com

Attachments: Auricore_SIG-v2.xlsx (attached in original)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jacobs <laura.jacobs@auricore.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity confirmation for SOC 2 Type II period gap

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear note and the SIG spreadsheet. We can provide a continuity confirmation memo.

Quick clarifications so we produce exactly what you need:
- Preferred signatory: would a Redwood compliance manager signature suffice, or do you require an executive (COO/CISO)?
- Date on memo: do you want it dated to the report end date (2026-09-30) or to the date of issuance?
- Delivery method: signed PDF via email or DocuSign?

We'll draft the memo and include any brief bullets about control adjustments since 2026-09-30. I will loop in Karthik and Marissa for a quick evidence check. We aim to have a draft by 11/25 and final by 11/30.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Manager, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0142

-----Original message forwarded-----
> Attachment referenced: Auricore_SIG-v2.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: continuity memo — confirm controls since 2026-09-30

Priya / Marissa —

Quick status: I validated the change log for the period 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-23 against our release notes and Jira. Notable items that should be mentioned in the memo:
- 2026-10-12: Hotfix to inference routing that updated a non-critical telemetry flag (no customer data exposure).
- 2026-10-30: Internal rollout of tighter RBAC for the staging cluster (administrative control improvement).
- 2026-11-02: Configuration tweak to KV cache sharding (performance; no access-control change).

All three items were evaluated by the controls team; none are material. We have compensating monitoring in place (audit log hooks and alerting) for the hotfix.

I attached suggested language for the memo and a short list of supporting evidence links. Marissa — can you produce a 1-page draft PDF (compliance memo) and attach the minimal evidence bundle (release notes excerpt, audit log snapshot)? Priya — once we have the draft, I'll review for technical accuracy.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: suggested_memo_text.txt, evidence_links.txt

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jacobs <laura.jacobs@auricore.com>, security@auricore.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Continuity confirmation memo — Redwood Inference (SOC 2 Type II post-period coverage)

Laura — attached is the continuity confirmation memo you requested (Redwood_SOC2_T2_continuity_memo_draft.pdf). Summary below:

- Report referenced: SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30.
- Coverage requested: period from 2026-10-01 through the date of this memo (2026-11-30).
- Controls summary: No material control changes affecting the scope of the SOC 2 report were identified during the post-report period.
- Notable operational changes: minor telemetry hotfix (2026-10-12), RBAC tightening in staging (2026-10-30), KV cache sharding tuning (2026-11-02). These items are non-material; monitoring and audit logging were used to validate.
- Signatory: Priya Natarajan, Manager, Trust & Compliance (Redwood Inference). If your procurement requires a CISO/COO signature, we can escalate.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_T2_continuity_memo_draft.pdf (signed), excerpt_release_notes.txt, audit_log_snapshot.csv

Please confirm if this meets Auricore's requirements or if you need an exec-signed attestation. Happy to route to our COO if necessary.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Manager, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
